approved_payload.content: Police, the army and the mine's own security moved on a group of armed illegal miners at the Kloof Gold Mine hostel in Westonaria on Wednesday 28 October, according to police. Sibanye Protection Services received information about the group at about 16:00 and asked the police Public Order Policing unit and the SANDF for help. Two men aged 32 and 35 were found with an AK-47 and an R5 rifle, and two more AK-47s were found abandoned. Police recovered three AK-47 rifles, one R5 rifle, six magazines, 246 live rounds and two Lesotho passports. The two men, Lesotho nationals, face charges of possessing unlicensed firearms and ammunition and were due in the Westonaria Magistrate's Court on 30 October. No one was killed or injured in the report. An arrest is not a conviction, and the accused are not named. Filed as Priority Intelligence (armed illegal mining), not as a crime pin. One source, the SAPS Gauteng statement of 29 October. The map point is estimated: the hostel is not mapped, so the pin is the Kloof mine area point.
